objective: Determine whether the native KNN joint final-score procedure has incremental margin distribution skill beyond chronological calibration of the fixed-parent Ridge margin procedure, and isolate training population effects.

evidence.nov27: 13 retained fixtures (12 primary and 1 identity/start hold) are discovery examples; permanently exclude these event identities from untouched confirmation. Retained audit is not predictive validation.
evidence.historical_comparator: cfb.fbs.matchup_efficiency.joint.v1.research is a distinct model from cfb.joint_final_score.knn256.v1.research; its Brier result is not transferable.
evidence.training_counts: Reported fit counts are not event-identity manifests: 15,074 fixed Ridge fit, 698 empirical residual calibration, 13,262 KNN fit. Selected point model is a different fitted parent.
evidence.caution: The 714-game historical conditional-scale evaluation compares different procedures and cannot supply B-C paired losses.

hypotheses.claim: Ridge margin center may be excessively extreme
Different training populations contribute to center discrepancy
KNN improves margin distribution beyond simple chronological calibration
Shared features omit important matchup context
Residual shape may be conditionally misspecified

target.scope: FBS versus FBS; week 2+ only where both native procedures admit; reconcile regulation/full-game OT and exact venue/teams/kickoff rules before admission
target.quantity: integer full-game home-minus-away final margin including overtime
target.market: quotes only after frozen native distributions; exact-line W/P/L descriptive where settlement supported; no invented lines or probability substitution

A.procedure: Retained fixed-parent empirical margin distribution, not the separate selected point head
A.freeze: Pin exact parent model, residual bank, transformation, support/conditioning and training cutoffs; original artifacts only on later eligible events; earlier chronological reconstructions distinct

B.procedure: cfb.joint_final_score.knn256.v1.research; marginalize retained paired final-score PMF to margin
B.freeze: Pin fit, KNN feature order, preprocessing, neighbour count=256, tie/settlement semantics; no earlier historical scoring of later fitted instance

C.procedure: Chronological linear calibration of A point center: alpha + beta*M_A; independent residual calibration of corrected prediction
C.fit: Fit alpha/beta only on earlier chronological OOF point forecasts from a same-procedure reconstruction of A, each with source/final availability receipts; no in-sample A prediction or future label; verify residual calibration disjoint from calibration-coefficient fitting and outer evaluation; retain actual predicted distribution mean separately; do not use market; no forced beta<1
C.fallback: If comparable OOF A forecasts cannot be recovered, C is unavailable; do not estimate from November 27 or in-sample fit

D1.procedure: Same-feature Ridge on matched fit events; independently calibrated empirical margin distribution
D1.freeze: Ridge hyperparameters, residual support/conditioning and calibration policy locked before confirmation

D2.procedure: Same-feature KNN256 on exactly D1 fit events; native joint final-score distribution
D2.freeze: Use the same event eligibility and training chronology, not the 698-game residual sample as the common fit universe

matched_population.outer_universe: Every scheduled in-scope fixture in a prospectively locked confirmation window, including held/refused/missing/unresolved events. Retain denominator, reason codes and comparison eligibility. Compare A/B/C on common scoreable events; D1/D2 on common scoreable events; compare A/B versus D1/D2 convergence only on four-way intersection. No post-outcome exclusions.
matched_population.fit_intersection: Per outer fold, unique stable canonical event IDs in the intersection of Ridge point-fit admissible FBS/FBS events and KNN point-fit admissible FBS/FBS events, with exact identical teams, orientation, kickoff, target, ten raw feature definitions/values and eligible source/final availability <= fitting cutoff. Conflicts fail closed. Fit preprocessing only on this intersection and pin ordered IDs and data hash. Residual/calibration is a separate role and chronological window; 698 is not a candidate fit-population denominator. Reserve the same earlier-only calibration/validation partitions for both arms, with no outer test events used in fit, tuning or calibration; record when a model does not require a separate calibration bank.
matched_population.chronology: Whole season-week blocks; expanding earlier folds, strict source availability and outcome availability, training/calibration before outer forecast cutoff, whole-week embargo where required by native source policy. No overlapping test event IDs or model selection on outer outcomes. A and B frozen-instance and reconstructed-procedure evaluation distinct. C uses nested chronological inner OOF, earlier correction fit, separate later earlier-than-test residual calibration; exact fold receipts required.

registration.primary_metric: event-weighted margin CRPS in points, exact admitted integer margin distribution and authenticated final margin; one score per event
registration.primary_contrast: B minus C on paired common events
registration.superiority_rule: One-sided 97.5% upper confidence bound for mean paired delta < -0.25; equivalently upper endpoint of two-sided 95% interval under consistent interval construction. No success merely because p<0.05 versus zero.

multiplicity.method: Fixed-sequence gatekeeping: primary B-C first at one-sided .025; only if it passes, test B-A at same alpha and MUE on same common A/B/C event population. Stop confirmatory claims if primary fails. D2-D1, C-A, convergence, all other metrics and subgroup results are prespecified secondary descriptive; unadjusted intervals labeled exploratory, no claims based on selected bins.

registration.confirmation_start_rule: After protocol, exact code/policy and cohort/power registration are independently time-anchored and no later test results are accessed; new prospective FBS events not part of discovery/tuning. First and last date/season-week, schedule-scope and stopping rule locked before execution. November 27 and all development/previously inspected outcomes excluded.

power.required_pilot: Earlier-only chronological per-event B-C paired CRPS losses, stable event IDs, season-week identities, fit/calibration/evaluation receipts, missingness accounting; pilot distinct from confirmation. No proxy from conditional-scale study or count of simulations.
power.method: Plan sample sizes using resampling whole contiguous four-week blocks within seasons from paired pilot differences, preserving within-week event counts; center pilot loss differences and shift to delta=-0.50. Simulate the predeclared one-sided upper-bound test against -0.25 for candidate numbers of weeks. Use event-weighted mean and the same block-bootstrap inference procedure, at least 10,000 replicates for final inference, fixed seed recorded in registration. Select minimum planned week and corresponding event count reaching >=80% simulated power, check sensitivity to 2- and 6-week block lengths and pilot variance; lock a fixed confirmation window with adequate planned coverage. Report realized sample and incomplete follow-up; no outcome-driven optional stopping.
power.notes: Thresholds are proposed planning choices in CRPS point units; justify utility before registration. No power number can be certified without relevant paired pilot loss variance/dependence.

registration.coverage_rule: All scheduled events retained; report per-arm forecast availability, paired coverage and exclusions. Proposed minimum 95% paired coverage of prospectively eligible events; fail to meet -> inconclusive confirmatory gate, still report descriptive common-event scores. Distinguish unknown outcome from forecast refusal. No imputation of unsupported forecasts.

diagnostics.bias: actual minus prediction; orient all arms to A's frozen favorite side for common bins; positive actual-minus-predicted means predicted favorite margin too small; negative means overprojection
diagnostics.calibration: Margin intercept/slope from actual margin on predicted margin; logistic calibration intercept/slope on binary decisive winner or explicit exact-line decisive settlement only, pushes retained separately. Slope <1 overly extreme; >1 too conservative after intercept. Do not silently clip endpoints; report boundary failures separately, use prespecified finite diagnostics only.

bins.convention: first [0,3], later (lower,upper], final >28; A absolute frozen point margin, not market or challenger bins; exact zero tie side defined by home orientation and flagged
bins.small_cells: Show counts and status INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE only; no comparative subgroup conclusion. Even eligible bins descriptive.

secondary: winner Brier and log loss on compatible binary target
exact-line W/P/L multiclass Brier and log loss only with verified contract and population
central 90% predictive interval coverage and width
diagnostics.uncertainty: Paired contiguous four-week block bootstrap stratified by season; 10,000 final resamples; sensitivity 2/6 weeks; record fixed seed and effective week count. All metrics event-weighted primary, slate/week-weighted sensitivity.

decision_rules.superiority: Require both fixed-sequence contrasts above MUE before evidence of incremental skill beyond C and A; calibration/coverage/width and availability guardrails separately reviewed; no automatic promotion.
decision_rules.equivalence: Only claim practically equivalent CRPS if prespecified paired CI lies wholly within +/-0.25 points, not just fails superiority.
decision_rules.matched_center_convergence: On four-way common events, require upper 95% descriptive CI for mean absolute D1-D2 point/expected margin gap <=1.0 point AND lower 95% descriptive CI for reduction in mean absolute gap versus A-B >=50% (if original gap >0); otherwise unresolved. Convergence is consistent with population effect but does not prove causal attribution if other procedures differ.
decision_rules.distribution_guardrails: Flag degradation if absolute deviation from nominal 90% interval coverage increases >3 pp or mean interval width grows >10% vs C or A (same matched events); these are proposed descriptive tolerances, not formal noninferiority tests. Better center with degraded intervals => MIXED_NO_PROMOTION; review CRPS, subgroup calibration, sharpness. Narrower width with poor coverage is not clearance.
cases: B-C and B-A pass, guardrails acceptable -> evidence of incremental skill, independent review only
B-A descriptively improves but B-C inconclusive -> no demonstrated value beyond simple calibration
B-C passes but B-A not -> no superiority to incumbent
B-C or B-A clearly worse -> negative result, preserve
equivalence CI contained in MUE band -> practically equivalent on that contrast
center better, coverage or width materially worsens -> mixed, no promotion

registration_blockers: exact A/B source and training/OOF cohort identities; C earlier-only loss/fit and residual calibration data
matched-fold manifest and actual executable runners/tests
untouched prospective confirmation population and stopping rule
relevant paired-loss pilot, dependence-aware power and sample size
review and freeze proposed MUE, guardrails and multiplicity, verified external time anchor
cbb: P0-B remains BLOCKED_ON_COHORT_RECOVERY for confirmatory registration. Recover historical matched total rows; retain bias and interval coverage as reported-not-reproduced; define MUE, primary signed-bias estimand, prospective cohort and power separately. Exploratory work remains enabled.
conformance: User-reported 0dff6ece seven real-source no-fit conformance runs and WNBA refusal/MLB supersession not retrievable at time of review; GitHub commit API returned 422. Do not mark independently verified or block this exploratory design on it.
